# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

LumenLive exists to serve churches and the people who run their services. We
want everyone who takes part in this project — filing issues, suggesting
features, or joining a discussion — to have a respectful, harassment-free
experience, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or
expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race,
religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful of differing viewpoints, experiences, and skill levels.
- Give and accept constructive feedback graciously.
- Assume good faith and focus on what is best for the project and its users.
- Use welcoming, inclusive language.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment of any kind, public or private.
- Sexualized language or imagery, or unwelcome sexual attention.
- Insulting, derogatory, or personal attacks.
- Publishing someone's private information without their explicit permission.
- Any other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces — the repository,
issues, pull requests, and discussions — and whenever someone is representing
the project in a public space.

## Enforcement

Report abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior by emailing
[hello@lumenlive.xyz](mailto:hello@lumenlive.xyz). All reports are
reviewed in confidence and will receive a response appropriate to the
circumstances. The maintainer may remove, edit, or reject contributions, or
restrict participation, for conduct that violates this Code of Conduct.
